newsitem.title: UK: Brent operator requests March cargo deferral - trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent operator requests March cargo deferral - trade.

text.p: North Sea Brent system operator Shell Expro has asked at least one Brent equity holder to defer a March Brent lifting into April, oil traders said on Thursday.
"Shell Expro is ringing asking people whether they're willing to defer March cargoes to April," a trader with one equity holder said.
Shell Expro had not given a reason for the requested deferrals, the trader said.
It was not known how many cargoes the company required deferred, although the requests were centred on end-month loadings.
A spokesman for Shell Expro said the company was not aware of any production problems in the Brent system.
Shell Expro operates in the North Sea on behalf of Royal Dutch/Shell Group and Exxon Corp.
